tess: flagging a smaller concern re: ownership semantics when adapter returns fd_hint. if runtime concurrently evicts a file, we can race close/fd reuse. propose adapter returns a lease token tied to FD to coordinate lifecycle.

omar: good catch. lease token idea sounds solid. can be opaque string + TTL + renew API.

li: TTL default could be 30s but warmup can request longer. also allow 'pin' operation for long-lived maps.

ci-agent: unit tests for lease-renew added to pipeline.

tess: ok will add to proto. also note: windows support will be hairy (no mmap fd semantics). adapter should fallback to read buffer path and document extra copy on windows.

omar: add telemetry flag when fd->buffer fallback happens.

li: also add metric for 'ownership transfer success rate' for first 24h after canary.

tess: neat. will update RFC and drop a short PR with proto and tests.
